comparisons.peer_topic: R&D Expense Increase and AI Headcount
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD's research and development expenses increased by 10% to $6.5 billion in 2024, primarily driven by higher employee-related costs resulting from an increase in headcount to support the company's AI strategy.
comparisons.comparison: Both QCOM and AMD report that their 2024 R&D expense increases were primarily driven by higher employee-related costs. However, the specific drivers differed: AMD’s increase was attributable to headcount growth supporting its AI strategy, whereas QCOM’s increase was driven by non-cash items, specifically share-based compensation and deferred compensation revaluation, despite overall restructuring efforts aimed at reducing employee-related costs in specific technology development areas.
